title: Maha Nadigan
desc: Sathya, a junior artiste, manages to secure a chance to play a hero in a movie. As his fame gradually increases, he decides to enter politics.

title: Thaikulame Thaikulame
desc: A man enters a bizarre circumstance that requires him to marry again. However, news about his second marriage reaches his first wife.

title: Pennin Manathai Thottu
desc: Sunil is a renowned heart surgeon, while Sunita has a child with a heart problem. When she meets Sunil, she lashes out at him, blaming him for her plight, as he had betrayed her many years ago.

title: Majunu
desc: Vasanth, the son of a wealthy politician, falls in love with Heena. However, soon she becomes a suspect in a bomb blast, leading Vasanth to protect her, unaware of the dark secret that awaits him.

title: Maaveeran
desc: Harsha gets falsely implicated for killing Indu's father. However, he soon realises that he and Indu share a bond from a previous life and sets out to set things straight.
